title: Choose Postgres over MySQL for the orders database
summary: Weighed MySQL against Postgres for the orders database and chose Postgres for its transactional guarantees and JSON support. MySQL was rejected as the orders store.

title: Add a Redis cache to the pricing service
summary: Added a Redis cache in front of the pricing service to cut repeated discount computations. First cache in the system.
attrs: Pricing service got a Redis cache on 2026-02-15

title: Migrate auth from server sessions to JWT
summary: Migrated authentication from server-side sessions to stateless JWT tokens to allow horizontal scaling of the auth service.
attrs: Auth moved from sessions to JWT on 2026-03-20

title: Add a Redis cache to the catalog service
summary: Added a second Redis cache, this time in front of the catalog service to speed up product listing reads.
attrs: Catalog service got a Redis cache on 2026-04-05

title: Roll back JWT auth to sessions after a token bug
summary: Rolled JWT authentication back to server sessions after a token-refresh bug logged users out. Auth is sessions again for now.
attrs: Auth rolled back from JWT to sessions on 2026-05-12

title: Pick Stripe as the payment provider
summary: Chose Stripe as the payment provider over Adyen and Braintree for its developer experience and test-mode tooling.
